newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bus crash kills eight children.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bus crash kills eight children.

text.p: Eight children were killed in Estonia on Friday when their school bus collided with a lorry that sheared along the vehicle and tore off its side, the Baltic News Service (BNS) agency and local officials said.
The accident happened in east central Estonia near the small settlement of Pala, 160 km (100 miles) from Tallinn, as the children were returning from a sports event.

Dozens of injured people were taken to hospital in the town of Tartu, 30 km (20 miles) away, BNS quoted police as saying. Police said the crash was not head-on as previously thought but the lorry sliced off the whole side of the bus.

A spokeswoman for the Pala administration confirmed that eight children were killed. "The picture was terrible, I don't want to talk about it," she told Reuters. "Some of them were disfigured beyond recognition."
Raivo Vadi, head of the Pala administration, said the lorry driver was also probably also killed. "It was a terrible scene," BNS quoted him as saying.
